Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answers up front: we can provide the Type II report (redacted where required), and we offer a bridge letter when the audit period ends outside your requested range. Audit period for the most recent Type II is 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30.

For delivery, we typically support three secure transfer options:
- Pre-signed S3 link (one-time, expiring) — recommended for larger bundles
- Secure Google Drive folder with restricted viewer access (for teams already on Drive)
- SFTP (partner provisioning) for long-term transfers

Minimal package we usually share for procurement review (attached as a one-page checklist):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — redact customer names where necessary
2) Bridge letter (if audit period gap)
3) Controls index / mapping (CSV or PDF)
4) Evidence inventory list (descriptive; no raw logs)
5) Sample log excerpt (redacted telemetry snippet) — only on request

Regarding KMS/HSM logs: those are treated as sensitive operational artifacts and are not bundled in the standard report. We can provide summarized statements about key management controls and redacted access summaries if you need them for control validation. If Acme requires raw logs for a formal audit, we'll need a documented NDA and a scoped transfer window.

Im attaching a concise checklist and our standard pre-signed S3 instructions. If that works, I can generate a pre-signed link and a short bridge letter draft for your review by EOD tomorrow (2026-11-26).

Next steps (proposed):
- Confirm preferred transfer mechanism
- Confirm whether a bridge letter is acceptable if you need coverage beyond 2026-06-30
- If raw logs required, confirm legal/data-handling contacts so we can route an NDA
